CustomField.description: QualifiedApiName of an alternate edit Form for a Table's single-row modal. Consumed by the legacy formTemplateSection render path (override-table-form-name); the current formTemplatePageSection path reads Alternate_FormQualifiedApiName__c instead. Prefer Alternate Form for new configurations.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Legacy field for the Table single-row edit form on the older page-section layout. For new templates, set the Alternate Form field instead; leave this blank unless you are maintaining a legacy section.
CustomField.label: FormQualifiedApiName
